draft.subject: order entry at Marlow
draft.body:
Hi Angela,

Tom Barlow at Fenwick Freight said you'd be the right person to talk to. I saw Marlow Parts Supply is hiring an order entry clerk to key purchase orders from email, around 60 a day.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Is this on your radar?

claims.text: Tom Barlow at Fenwick Freight said you'd be the right person to talk to
Marlow Parts Supply is hiring an order entry clerk to key purchase orders from email, around 60 a day
We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business

evidence.text: Order Entry Clerk. Enter customer purchase orders received by email into the order system; 60+ orders a day.
No online ordering portal, customer login or EDI page was found on the website.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
